description:
A restaurant manager needs to add a newly hired cashier to the Floreant POS system. Starting from the main Floreant POS terminal screen, navigate to the Back Office and add a new employee with the following details:

- First Name: Maria
- Last Name: Santos
- Secret Key (Password/PIN): 2345
- Type: CASHIER

Steps:
1. Click BACK OFFICE on the main terminal screen.
2. Enter the manager PIN: 1111, then click LOGIN.
3. Navigate to the Users explorer section.
4. Add a new user.
5. Fill in the details (Maria, Santos, 2345, CASHIER).
6. Save the new user record.
